## Summary

Describe the change and the motivation behind it. Link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (import, CLI, MCP, or browser app)
- [ ] Format change (spec, schema, and vectors updated together)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or internal cleanup

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for this change.
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` is clean.
- [ ] `bun test` passes.
- [ ] If the format changed, `spec/SPEC.md`, `spec/keepsake-v1.schema.json`, and
      `spec/vectors.json` are updated together and the vectors are regenerated.
- [ ] If behavior or flags changed, docs (`README.md` or the spec) are updated.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
